details: Assigned: isolated scatter_matmul mini-op bake-off (local L1 matmul + column reduce-scatter). Reading op kernels for honest baseline.

Read prior benches (reduce_scatter_swiglu, reduce_accum_mechanism, reduce_transport_shape) + op compute matmul_block call. Plan: scatter_matmul mini-op = zero-copy tensor-backed L1 CBs for x(bfp8)/wg,wu(bfp4_b), matmul_block per matrix -> pg/pu (bfp8), then column reduce over 5 shapes x 4 accum mechs. Separate landing CB per contributor so dest_acc/pack_l1_pair chains can name operands at compile time; transport cost identical (same writes, different base).

test_geometry PASS. L1 table: at m_eff=8,N=12 (T=96) tree/direct are L1-INFEASIBLE (>1.38MB) while scatter (1279K) and ring (1253K) fit - landing L1 is O(T) for scatter/ring vs O(slots*T)+O(T) accumulator+send for tree/direct. Fixed a real deadlock: tree/direct compute must fold gate AND up in the SAME per-child iteration, else the reader cannot re-reserve land_u[slot] before inviting c+slots.

All 11 correctness cells PASS, no hangs. PCC: addchain 0.999759, tree 0.999842, pack_l1_acc/dest_acc/pack_l1_pair 0.999888 (better - they skip intermediate bfp8 requantization). Fixed: tensor cache must be keyed on the live device (per-test fixture) or the next generic_op throws cq_id-out-of-range.

K=8 m=8 N=6 KR=28, 88 cores. mm_only floor 35096 ns. NET reduce cost: scatter_dual+pack_l1_pair 8997 | ring 9878 | scatter_dual+dest_acc 11091 | scatter_dual+addchain 11957 | scatter+pack_l1_pair 13816 | scatter+dest_acc 15879 | scatter+addchain 16843 (SHIPPED) | tree s1 17502 | tree s2 19714 | direct s2 33862 | direct s1 36126. THREE findings: (1) NoC-split gate/up across the two DM RISCs is worth 29pct of the reduce; (2) ring BEATS all-to-all scatter by 41pct - same total bytes but 1-hop neighbour transfers instead of column-wide all-to-all, i.e. hop-bytes not bytes; (3) tree is only 3.8pct worse than scatter here, so the shipped scatter 2.80x was the DISTRIBUTED EPILOGUE not the reduce transport.

direct/tree reader hang at small T root-caused via triage: root NCRISC parked in noc_async_atomic_barrier while every contributor sat in noc_semaphore_wait_min(invite). Fix = drop the post-priming barrier and keep exactly one per-invite flush inside the recycling loop plus one trailing flush. Verified direct T=48/24/12/6/4/2 all PCC 0.99975. Also fixed a Python UnboundLocalError (got) that masqueraded as two probe failures.

224+87 tests green, zero hangs. WINNER scatter_dual+pack_l1_pair 44212 ns vs shipped-equivalent scatter+addchain 52065 ns at focus (-15.1pct composite, -46pct of the reduce), PCC 0.999889 vs 0.999759 (BETTER). Predicate: wins 20/20 m_eff x N cells (-14.2 to -29.1pct) and 9/9 KGROUPS cells (K=4 -7.7pct, K=8 -15.1pct, K=10 -18.9..-23.9pct), zero regressions. Resource saved = NoC injection occupancy (gate on NOC_1 / up on NOC_0) + PACK call count (ceil(K/2) chain calls instead of K). NOT arithmetic. Composite is matmul-bound: mm_only floor 35111 ns = 79pct of winner.

Team lead: (1) generated/profiler is SHARED between concurrent runs - must export TT_METAL_PROFILER_DIR to a private dir and RE-TAKE every number; (2) math utilisation is the headline, computed as roofline_ns/T with roofline = M_t*K_t*N_t*16 cycles at 1.35GHz (16 cyc/tile-MAC, NOT 8), using mm_only as the control rather than a fidelity delta; (3) fidelity delta is a LOWER BOUND = fraction of FPU work EXPOSED, not FPU time. My earlier 13 cyc/tile-MAC claim was an arithmetic slip: 715 ns/T-tile x 1.35 / 56 tile-MACs = 17.2 cyc, i.e. mm_only is ~93pct of the 16-cyc roofline. Re-running everything with an isolated profiler dir.

358 tests green with PRIVATE TT_METAL_PROFILER_DIR. Numbers reproduce the pre-isolation run within 0.4pct so nothing was corrupted, but all reported values are now post-isolation. MATH UTIL at focus (roofline 31858 ns = 2688 tile-MACs x 16 cyc / 1350 MHz): mm_only 90.7pct, winner scatter_dual+pack_l1_pair 72.2pct, shipped scatter+addchain 61.1pct, direct 44.7pct. Resident operands take util from the real op 38pct to 61-75pct and the reduce SHAPE is worth 27 points. Fidelity probe: exposure 102-106pct on every shape/cell, HiFi2 vs HiFi4 slopes agree to 3-4pct - nothing overlaps the FPU here. Measured pass = 17.0/16.3 cyc per tile-MAC so the 16-cyc constant is right to 2-6pct. 2x4 factorial: dual-NoC and pack_l1_pair are ADDITIVE to within 1-2pct.
